author: tbrooks92
quote: GTA 6 is a massive disappointment and honestly one of the most boring games in recent memory. Definitely not worth the hype or the long wait.

author: tbrooks92
quote: The developers do not listen to the community! Developers have been driving this game into the ground patch after patch since launch. Instead of addressing the issues the players actually have with the game that would make the game better they continue to make the game worse by nurfing every part of the game. The reward quantity and quality are not enough to keep players engaged/playing. Endgame is terrible!
